issue.description: The frozen JSON Schema fixed candidate_trial_evidence to exactly 1728 rows, which is only the 54-site two-block conformance fixture. The frozen candidate-site algorithm instead includes every transformer block, and the executable validator derives the live cardinality from the authorized candidate inventory.

live_cardinality.definition: C = 3 * sum(transformer_block_count for each of the nine authorized model units)

successor.structural_rule: candidate_trial_evidence has a frozen minimum of 1728 and no false fixed maximum; exact dynamic cardinality is derived from the authorization by the semantic validator
validation_composition: validate the report against this successor JSON Schema
require both validations to pass before creating an execution lock

supersession.applies_to: future live OSS-1 site-discovery reports only
supersession.parent_schema_role: historical frozen design evidence and two-block conformance fixture
supersession.successor_schema_role: structural schema required for any live report

authorization_effect.next_gate: content-addressed dependency-cluster registry and concrete discovery authorization

claim_boundary: This correction repairs a validator cardinality defect. It does not strengthen evidence, certify runtime execution, prove ancestry completeness, or change the named-dependency-cluster engineering-pilot ceiling.
